events.what_it_is: A Dunkin' sampling truck at Pier 17 serving drink samples and promotional swag.
events.what_is_free: Free samples of Iced Pumpkin Latte, Berry Clementine Refresher and Strawberry Dragon Fruit Refresher, plus Dunkin' swag, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Open to the public; samples and swag are while supplies last. No advance reservation requirement was published in the sources checked.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, 2:30–6 PM at Pier 17 / the Seaport.

events.event_name: Cafe Yaeji: Free Oatly Gochujang Lattes
events.what_it_is: A two-day Korean-dabang-inspired cafe collaboration from Oatly and artist/producer Yaeji.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary iced Gochujang Lattes made with espresso, Oatly Barista Edition, gochujang-vanilla base, salted vanilla cold foam and gochugaru.
events.caveats: Open public pop-up. Complimentary drinks are the advertised offer; availability is inherently capacity/supply dependent.
events.practical_notes: Saturday and Sunday Sept. 19–20, 9 AM–3 PM each day at 48 Ludlow Street.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's three-day cafe and retail pop-up celebrating the Mocha Magic fragrance launch.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling and a special gift for the first 50 people in line each day; the pop-up also has drinks, retail merchandise and gifts with purchase.
events.caveats: A Partiful guest list is available, but the checked sources do not establish that RSVP controls admission; treat it as optional rather than guaranteed access. First-50 gifts are limited daily.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily. The pop-up is explicitly described as open to the public for retail.

events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum NYC Pop-Up at Herald Square
events.what_it_is: An open-air Max Mara fragrance launch pop-up outside Macy's Herald Square with scent discovery, games, photo moments and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary gelato, fragrance samples and chances to win promotional prizes/giveaways, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Free Eventbrite registration is available. Promotional samples, gelato and giveaway items are subject to supply. The Eventbrite listing does not establish organizer-selection/approval access.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–6 PM at Macy's Herald Square Plaza, 151 W 34th St.

events.event_name: Brown Bee × Pura Vida Nolita Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A two-day Brown Bee collaboration at Pura Vida Nolita combining a smoothie promotion with beauty-product gifting.
events.what_is_free: For the first 100 qualifying visitors: a PB smoothie, a full-size product and an exclusive Brown Bee gift.
events.caveats: Open to the public. The advertised giveaway is limited to the first 100; sources do not establish an advance reservation requirement.
events.practical_notes: Friday and Saturday Sept. 18–19, 10 AM–6 PM daily at Pura Vida Nolita.

events.what_it_is: A one-day public KILIAN PARIS activation celebrating the fragrance brand's Cocktails Collection.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples; exclusive gifts are tied to purchase and are while supplies last.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Samples/mocktails are complimentary while supplies last; the exclusive gift requires a purchase.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, 12–8 PM at 401 W 14th Street / Chelsea Triangle area.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-themed Apothékary takeover at SUKOSHI with tongue readings, tincture sampling and kakigori.
events.what_is_free: Product sampling, kakigori while supplies last, and a mini Apothékary tincture for the first 50 guests in line each day; gifts with purchase are separate.
events.caveats: The host promotion says RSVP, but the direct Eventbrite destination was not independently recovered in this pass. Do not invent a URL. First-50 minis and kakigori are supply-limited.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18: 1–9 PM. Saturday–Sunday Sept. 19–20: 9 AM–9 PM. Host-side social evidence corroborates the address, dates and programming.
